text:
elena (support): FYI customer Brightline says their monthly subscription invoice is missing the PO number so AP won't auto-pay. Invoice ID inv_2026_03_14_9087, amount $12,450, subscription sub_bright_001. They need a reissued invoice with PO ASAP.

mike (billing): @elena can you confirm if the invoice is already marked paid or still open? If paid, we'll do credit + reissue; if unpaid maybe void+recreate depending on gateway.

elena (support): It's still OPEN. Payment attempt failed with card decline because their AP system blocks invoices w/o PO. Log snippet from gateway: `status: payment_failed, reason: blocked_by_payer_policy, code: PO_REQUIRED`.

anna (support): Customer sent PO #BR-7582 after the invoice was created. They want it attached to the March invoice rather than waiting for April. They prefer a reissue (same totals, same tax) so their AP can match.

mike (billing): Since it's OPEN we can do either: 1) Void+reissue (preferred if invoice hasn't been collected anywhere), or 2) Issue a credit note and create a new invoice with PO included. Policy note: void path preserves invoice numbering gap policies? Finance needs to confirm VAT handling for the credit. @luca

luca (finance): For VAT we prefer Void+reissue when possible to avoid two taxable documents in same period; credit+reissue is fine but requires linking credit note to original invoice for audit trail. If invoice already posted to accounting (closed in QuickBooks), credit path is mandatory. Ask AP if they require original invoice number on new doc.

mike (billing): OK. Elena, can you confirm if inv_2026_03_14_9087 has been exported to accounting? Use `GET /exports/invoices?invoice_id=inv_2026_03_14_9087` and paste the export_id if present.

elena (support): Ran the export check: returned empty. Not exported.

mike (billing): Good. We'll proceed with Void + Reissue. Steps I will run (planned):
1) Void invoice in billing system: `POST /invoices/inv_2026_03_14_9087/actions` payload: `{ "action": "void", "reason": "attach PO BR-7582 requested by customer" }`
2) Create new invoice referencing subscription sub_bright_001, add PO: `{ "subscription_id": "sub_bright_001", "po_number": "BR-7582", "items": [...], "metadata": {"reissue_of": "inv_2026_03_14_9087"} }`
3) Mark customer notified and resend to AP email.

anna (support): One small ask from customer: they need the invoice date to remain 2026-03-14 for internal reconciliation. Is that possible?

mike (billing): We can set `issue_date` on the new invoice to 2026-03-14 but we need finance sign-off because it changes bookkeeping period if exports had happened. Since no export yet, Luca ok? @luca

luca (finance): That's acceptable if bookkeeping entries remain in the same period and we document the reissue reason. Set issue_date to 2026-03-14 and tag `reissued_from` in metadata. We'll require the credit memo/void audit log.

mike (billing): Cool. I'll run the void and create new invoice with PO and same issue_date. ETA ~30m. I'll paste the commands & audit IDs when done.

billing-bot: Credit/void action queued for inv_2026_03_14_9087 by mike (billing). Job ID job_87234.

mike (billing): Void successful. Audit ID: audit_void_87234. Creating new invoice now: new_invoice_id inv_2026_03_14_9087_r1 (internal). Payload used: `{\n  "subscription_id": "sub_bright_001",\n  "po_number": "BR-7582",\n  "issue_date": "2026-03-14",\n  "items": [{"description":"Monthly subscription - March","qty":1,"unit_price":12450}],\n  "metadata": {"reissued_from":"inv_2026_03_14_9087","finance_approval":"luca"}\n}`

billing-bot: Invoice inv_2026_03_14_9087_r1 created and emailed to billing@brightline.com. Export status: not exported.

elena (support): Customer confirmed receipt and that their AP accepted PO field. They'll attempt payment retry.

mike (billing): Marking original invoice voided and linking new invoice. I'll add note to thread and attach audit screenshot in ticket system.

sarah (support): Great job. Please add the void + recreate steps to the internal KB: path billing/reissues/void-and-reissue-subscription so we have this flow documented for future. Also add a short blurb about setting issue_date and finance sign-off.

mike (billing): Will do. Closing here once payment is successful.

elena (support): Payment retried and succeeded at 2026-03-14T15:20:11Z. New invoice inv_2026_03_14_9087_r1 is PAID. Leaving note to close ticket. :white_check_mark:
